articles.headline: Struggling Ravens noncommittal on whether Humphrey will play Sunday vs. Texans
articles.description: A day after he was a healthy scratch in a 35-33 loss at the Panthers following a derogatory comment he made about the city of Baltimore, the Ravens were noncommittal on whether cornerback Marlon Humphrey would play Sunday against the Texans.
